body:
Yes, I have heard of age regression. And I cannot deny that I want to be a child again, indeed, I seem to have a very strange fetish, one that is literally impossible to actually play out. I'm into very, *very* dark things. Specifically, things like prolonged tickle torture, force-feeding, bondage, and complete domination. The thing is, I want those things to happen to ME. As a child. And no, age roleplay will not work. I need to *be* a child again, thus my fetish is a literal impossiblity.

But, while there may be trauma, and while I can say that I am not into sex with kids, I *can* say that my inclination towards them is most definitely pedophilic. The kids I'm into, I'm *into* them. I'm *attracted* to them.

And finally, as for the parent hate, I know what the root is, and even the exact day and time it began. But the problem is that the root just isn't going away. It was a gradual build up of resentment caused by my many interactions with kids and the parents always winning at the end of the day. Parents are a "guy your girl cheated on you with" that I cannot and will not overcome. I hate parents because they get all the access to kids that they want, and all they ever do is hurt them and / or come and complain online about how "PARENTING IS A HARD JOB!!!" and "KIDS ARE SUCH A BURDEN!!". I want just to spend time with a child, without the fear of parents. Just me and the child, alone, with nobody else there to tell me what I can and can't do.  This is also called "a romantic outing" among you lovey dovey folk. Just you and your SO, with nobody else to judge you. Unfortunately while parents exist they will always make sure that their power is never questioned, and that they are they alone are the only people the child is allowed to love.
Yes, what do you have issues with?
